description: Viktor Paul Müller publishes HEDS, a standalone browser simulator for hourly household electricity demand. Zenodo supplies an HTML application and text README under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Users define device power, weekday and weekend schedules, seasonal multipliers and optional daily variation; the tool combines household loads and exports hourly CSV or XLSX results, with JSON configuration files for reruns. It can prepare demand scenarios for PV, battery and demand-management studies. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this browser-based household tool. A limitation is that the preset household types and plus-or-minus ten-percent stochastic variation are illustrative assumptions, not calibrated meter data. Coverage is a user-configured household and year, not a national load profile. The HTML was not downloaded or operated, and no exported load curve was checked.
